carpet.rule.endGatewayCooldown.name: End Gateway Cooldown
carpet.rule.endGatewayCooldown.desc: Disables the 2-second cooldown between end gateway teleports. Enable to allow unlimited teleportation without cooldown.
carpet.rule.itemEntityAlarm.name: Item Entity Alarm
carpet.rule.itemEntityAlarm.desc: When the number of item stacks in a single chunk reaches the configured threshold, alerts all players in chat with coordinates and count. The threshold can be set to 1000 / 2000 / 4000 / 6000, or any custom positive integer; set to 0 to disable the alarm.
carpet.rule.railForceStatePlacement.name: Rail Force State Placement
carpet.rule.railForceStatePlacement.desc: Only affects rails placed with Easy Place (Litematica, protocol V3): the rail is placed with the schematic shape, unsupported/floating rails can be placed, and the placement does not reshape surrounding rails. After the placement transaction ends, all rails behave normally again (redstone shape changes, unsupported rails falling, etc. are unaffected).
When enabled with flippinCactus, right-clicking rails with cactus cycles through all valid shapes without triggering block or neighbor updates.
carpet.rule.trialSpawnerIntervalFix.name: Trial Spawner Interval Fix
carpet.rule.trialSpawnerIntervalFix.desc: When enabled, trial spawners in the chamber_8 and encounter_4 structures of trial chambers use the normal 20gt (1 second) spawn interval instead of 160gt (8 seconds).
